name: i8n-ocr-bench
description: i8n-ocr-bench is a multilingual OCR benchmark designed to evaluate OCR systems across diverse scripts and languages using real-world document images. It measures recognition accuracy and robustness to script-specific tokenization and layout variations. The benchmark is intended to stress-test both traditional OCR pipelines and modern vision-language/sequence-transcription models.
evaluation_method: Character Error Rate (CER) / Word Error Rate (WER) and exact_match
reputation: Niche and specialized dataset with limited but growing use in multilingual OCR research.
